entries.title: Private sites moved to Integrations, in one box
entries.body: The private sites a crewmate's browser may open now live in Settings → Integrations, beside the other things your crew can reach, instead of in General. One box holds the list, each site's Remove and a + Site button that opens the field right where you add it. A suffix such as .corp.example.com says that it covers every name under it, and Allow on your first mate's card now opens Integrations with the site listed.

picture.alt: Settings, Integrations, the Private sites box listing wiki.corp.example and .corp.example.com and every name under it, each with Remove, above a + Site button
